prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1474; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type cervical injury. The mechanism of injury is well matched to the reported symptoms. Over the course of care the patient attended 21 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury, with treatment including manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Cervical range of motion was restricted on initial examination, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced strength noted. Imaging and clinical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical spine. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving the neck or upper back. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Current status shows gradual improvement in pain and mobility, and the patient has been discharged to a self-directed home program with follow-up as needed.
